title: Antero Platform
subtitle: Enterprise Logistics Operations Platform
shortDescription: A centralized platform for logistics operations covering shipment, pickup, manifest, delivery, POD, finance visibility, operational integrations — and an AI analyst layer.
longDescription: Antero is the internal operations platform used daily by a cargo network handling 17,000+ shipments per month. It consolidates shipment, pickup, manifest, delivery, POD, and finance workflows — previously spread across fragmented processes — into one Next.js platform with a Supabase/PostgreSQL data layer, custom RBAC + MFA auth, integrations into accounting and external services, a PWA surface with push notifications and in-browser scanning, and an Executive Analyst agent built on LangGraph that answers operational questions over real data.
problem: Logistics operations spanning shipment, pickup, manifest, delivery, POD, and finance were spread across fragmented workflows that needed a shared system.
solution: A centralized internal platform that consolidates operational workflows and gives the team visibility into shipment, manifest, delivery, and finance data, with integrations into external systems — plus an AI analyst that lets staff query operations in natural language.
responsibilities: Builds and maintains operational modules across the shipment lifecycle
Designed the custom RBAC + MFA layer on cookie-session/JWT auth
Built the Executive Analyst — a LangGraph agent answering operational questions over real data
Integrated external systems — Accurate Online accounting, OBL, MaxMind GeoIP
Keeps quality gates green — Playwright E2E, Vitest, k6 load tests, Lighthouse CI
features: Operational workflow digitization — shipment, pickup, manifest, delivery, POD
Finance visibility via Accurate Online / Accurate.id integration
Executive Analyst — LangGraph agent over live operational data
Custom RBAC with MFA and cookie-session auth
PWA — web-push notifications and in-browser barcode scanning
Realtime dashboards — Recharts + Mantine charts over operations
technology: PostgreSQL via Supabase — RLS, migrations, direct pg pool
Cookie session + JWT — custom RBAC, MFA
Claude Agent SDK / OpenAI / Ollama / OpenRouter — multi-provider LLM

decisions.title: Visibility over novelty
decisions.rationale: Operations staff needed a trustworthy shared view of shipments and finance first; optimizations were added where they were safe.

decisions.title: AI as analyst, not operator
decisions.rationale: The Executive Analyst answers questions over operational data — mutations still go through explicit, auditable workflows.

decisions.title: Postgres-first access control
decisions.rationale: Supabase RLS plus a direct pg pool and explicit migrations keep data access enforced at the database, not just the API.

impact: Runs daily operations for a cargo network handling 17,000+ shipments per month
Brings AI assistance into real operational workflows via the Executive Analyst
Consolidates operational workflows into a shared system
